$comment: Single source of truth, consumed by BOTH eslint.config.mjs (which enforces
the rules) and tests/arch/*.test.ts (which prove the enforcement works).
One definition means the tests cannot drift from the real config and
JSON because an .mjs ESLint config and .ts tests must both import it
See Build Plan §7 (model adapter boundary) and §14 (secrets).
providerSdkMessage: Provider SDKs may only be imported inside lib/model/. Use the AtlasModel interface instead (Build Plan §7). Adding a provider means adding an adapter, not scattering SDK calls through the codebase.
processEnvMessage: Import validated config from lib/env/ instead of reading process.env directly (Build Plan §14). This keeps every variable schema-checked and keeps server secrets out of client bundles.
